text:
maya: Dropping a lightweight thread for the onboarding-first-run artifacts. Sharing a compact concept: top-of-dashboard inline banner that expands to a side panel (no modal). Need quick UX and accessibility checks.
dan: Link please? Prefer no modal for desktop. Keep flow resumable.
maya: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXX/onboard-inline (mock link). Banner has three-step checklist and a "Start your first project" CTA.
olivia: Love the wording change. Accessibility note: primary CTA contrast measures ~2.7:1 on the current palette  needs AA. Also ensure focus ring visible on dark theme.
jamie: For analytics, we should fire onboarding.step_shown, onboarding.step_completed, and onboarding.completed with durations. Also add an event when user clicks "Try sample project" and which template chosen.
design: Copy tweak: try "Start your first project" + microcopy "~5 mins with sample data". Step labels: "Create API key", "Run sample request", "Inspect results". Keep labels <=3 words.
aria: Sample projects: propose "Support helper" (low-cost chat) and "FAQ search" (embeddings demo). Add tiny badges: "low-cost" and "interactive". Include token estimate and expected latency under each card.
maya: Snippet guidance: show curl + minimal JS snippet. Keep code short so people can paste fast.
dan: UX question: where to surface progress later? I'd avoid adding progress in top nav. Maybe a subtle dot on avatar that expands to the checklist on click (low visual weight).
olivia: Keyboard + screen reader needs: Banner should be reachable via skip links, the panel should set aria-describedby, and completion messages should go to aria-live. Also add aria-labels for progress (e.g., "Onboarding: 1 of 3 complete").
jamie: QA list for handoff: keyboard navigation, visible focus, color contrast tests, run axe, and one SR pass (NVDA/VoiceOver). Design to mark color tokens for high-contrast variant.
design: I'll update Figma today with collapsed banner state, expanded panel, both CTA colors, and copy variants.
aria: I'll write two READMEs for the sample projects with estimated tokens, a short payload example, and a note about cost tradeoffs.
onboarding-bot: automation: emit onboarding.completed when last step completed, and set user flag onboarding.shown=false.
maya: Action items: design updates Figma (design); readmes (aria); snippets (dan); analytics events (jamie). Review scheduled 11:00 AM PT tomorrow. :thumbsup:
